definitions.explanation: Being older than someone else; a person who is older.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}より{三|さん}{歳|さい}{年上|としうえ}だ。
examples.english: He is three years older than me.

examples.japanese: {年上|としうえ}の{人|ひと}に{敬語|けいご}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To use polite language with older people.

examples.japanese: {妻|つま}は{私|わたし}より{年上|としうえ}です。
examples.english: My wife is older than me.

notes:
FORMS:
{年|とし} (age, year) + {上|うえ} (above) → above in years = older

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜より{年上|としうえ} - older than ~
- {年上|としうえ}の{人|ひと} - older person
- {三|さん}{歳|さい}{年上|としうえ} - three years older

USAGE:
Used to describe age relationships between people. Important in Japanese culture where age often determines social hierarchy and language use.

NOTE ON RELATIONSHIPS:
{年上|としうえ}の{彼女|かのじょ}/{彼氏|かれし} often refers to a romantic partner who is older, sometimes significantly so.
